newsitem.title: JAPAN: JVC, Nippon TV to invest 1 bln yen in French movie.
newsitem.headline: JVC, Nippon TV to invest 1 bln yen in French movie.

text.p: Victor Co of Japan (JVC) said on Thursday that it and Nippon Television Network Corp had agreed with the French motion picture firm Gaumont to invest more than one billion yen in a movie currently being produced in Hollywood.
The science fiction movie, titled "The Fifth Element", stars American actor Bruce Willis and is directed by Luc Besson, a spokesman for the audiovisual equipment maker said.

JVC and Nippon Television Network, a nationwide broadcasting firm, have obtained various marketing rights to the movie in Japan, including broadcasting, distribution and video and digital video disc sales, the spokesman said.
The movie is scheduled to open in France and the United States in May.
